info.title: beesharp - run presets headlessly and inspect exported run bundles without the UI
info.description: Command-line tool (beesharp) for running load-test presets headlessly and inspecting exported or live Beesharp runs.

options.name: --preset
options.description: The preset to run: its name, or the path of a preset .json file. Required.

options.name: --env
options.description: The environment whose {{Key}} values are filled in. Needed when the preset uses placeholders.

options.name: --root
options.description:
Folder with presets/, environments/, scripts/ (preflight/, shutdown/) and data/.
Default: the current directory.

options.name: --storage
options.description:
duckdb (default): save the run to <root>/data/beesharp.duckdb, so the server's UI shows it in the history.
memory: save nothing.

options.name: --duration
options.description: Run for this long instead of the preset's duration.

options.name: --progress
options.description: Print a progress line this often (default 5, 0 = none).

options.name: --logs
options.description: Stream live scenario logs (trace|debug|info|warn|error; default info).

options.name: --json
options.description: Print summary as JSON to stdout (suppresses chatter), or also write JSON to <file>.

options.name: --export
options.description: Export the finished run to a file or directory.

options.name: --export-format
options.description: Export format: parquet, duckdb, json, or csv (inferred from --export path when omitted).

options.name: --help
options.description:
This text.
The run starts with the preflight, then the scenario entries, then the shutdown program (as in the UI).
Ctrl+C stops the run like Stop in the UI: bees in flight are canceled, the shutdown program still runs, the run is saved.
Exit codes:
0  all bees succeeded
1  at least one bee failed or was canceled (also: stopped with Ctrl+C, shutdown program failed)
2  the run could not run: bad arguments, preset or environment not found, a script does not compile,
an unknown {{placeholder}}, the preflight failed

commands.name: Conventions
commands.description:
Scenario entries, steps, and bees are 1-based (matching the UI: entry 1, step 1, bee 1 = B1).
--json is a pure boolean flag on all "runs" commands and prints untruncated camelCase JSON to stdout.

commands.name: trace
commands.description: One bee's distributed trace as a flat span list (depth, service, self time, share)

options.name: --url
options.description: Query a running Beesharp server (also uses BEESHARP_URL if target is not a local file).

options.name: --call
options.description: Only the spans below call <n> of the bee (1-based, as numbered by "runs bee").

options.name: --max-spans
options.description: Show at most <n> spans (1 to 5000, default 50); over that the spans with the largest self time are kept.

options.name: --json
options.description: Print untruncated JSON to stdout.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help text.
Each line: depth, service, span name, duration, self time (the span's own time, without its children) and its share of the bee's (or call's) duration,
error flag, HTTP status and key attributes such as db.query.text. Needs the trace to be fetched into the run (a TraceStore.* environment).
Exit codes: 0 shown, 2 invalid arguments or run/bee not found, 3 the trace is not stored with the run (the message gives the likely reason).

arguments.name: TARGET
arguments.description:
Exported run bundle (.zip, .duckdb, or .json) or run ID / latest / prev with --url.
<bee|traceId> A bee (1-based: 5 or B5) or a trace ID (32 hex characters, as printed by the slowest calls and by "runs bee").
